name: Cluster Mei Bagwani Ki Yojana
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be an individual farmers/ farmers group/ Farmers Producer Organisation (FPO)/ cooperative society or registered institution.
   1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres and a maximum of 10 acres (25 acres for cluster area).
   1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

<br>
